title: Normalized QuickGO Annotations
description: Validation contract for normalized Gene Ontology annotations exported from MFP_QuickV1 under scheme MFPB_QUICKGO_ANNOTATION_V1. Preserves 1:1 row bijection with raw annotations while standardizing aspect vocabulary, binding entity protein_id, and assigning neutral qualifier status.

annotation_id.description: Deterministic unique annotation identifier binding capture scope to database row PK.

protein_id.description: Catalog entity identifier resolved from candidate v0.3.0 mfp_proteins.csv.

uniprot_accession.description: Canonical UniProtKB accession matching cohort input.

database_protein_id.description: Retained database protein identifier from raw table protein.id.

database_annotation_id.description: Retained database primary key from protein_go_term_annotation.id.

go_aspect.description: Normalized controlled vocabulary for GO aspect (BP, MF, CC).

evidence_code.description: Standard 2-letter or 3-letter Gene Ontology evidence code.

reference_type.description: Classified citation reference namespace or null if unreferenced.

reference_id.description: Bare numeric PubMed ID or canonical GO_REF CURIE string, or null.

qualifier_status.description: Fixed neutral qualifier status reflecting uncaptured qualifier column in MFP_QuickV1.

assigned_by.description: Explicit schema null representing uncaptured assigned_by attribute.
